changes: Replaced in-place `list.sort()` calls in `newest_ids` and `owner_ids` with non-mutating `sorted()` calls. Added regression tests confirming export order remains unchanged and equal creation-time rows retain import order.
diagnosis: The read-only views sorted the caller-owned `rows` list in place. Opening either sorted view therefore permanently changed the sequence later consumed by `export_ids`.
verification: Ran `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`: all 5 tests passed. Also compiled the implementation and tests with `python3 -m py_compile` successfully.
